rollups.text: Live-music experiences and interests: attended a Billie Eilish concert with sister at Wells Fargo Center, Philadelphia, on 2023-03-18; attended a free outdoor park concert on 2023-03-25 and enjoyed discovering new talent; attended a Brooklyn music festival with friends by 2023-04-01 and saw Glass Animals; attended an intimate local-bar jazz night on 2023-04-08; attended a jazz concert at a local club by 2023-03-26 and bought the saxophonist’s album; saw Queen with Adam Lambert at Prudential Center in Newark with parents on an unspecified date. The user is interested in indie/alternative music, jazz, and finding new artists through live performances.

Television shows watched, paused, or considered: finished Fleabag around 2023-04-01 after binge-watching it over five days; watched Schitt's Creek through episode 4 before pausing it for Stranger Things season 4; began The Great British Baking Show/The Great British Bake Off the previous month and stopped at episode 4; was two episodes behind on Succession as of 2023-04-15; watched The Crown season 4 episode 1 on a Sunday in March 2023 and wanted to resume; planned to try the first one or two episodes of Killing Eve. The user loves period dramas and shows about royalty.

Games played or considered: got a gaming laptop in March 2023 and played Sekiro and Overwatch on it without issues; took a one-week break from demanding games and played Clash Royale and PUBG; considered Ghost of Tsushima but worried it might feel too much like Sekiro; later considered another break from demanding games and was excited to try the more relaxed Plants vs. Zombies. The user also has a team 2D platformer project with coin scoring and is considering adding timed speed and invincibility power-ups.

Pets and care: the user has a kitten named Luna, acquired on February 10 in an unspecified year. Luna chases the user's laser pointer, sleeps often in a recently acquired pet bed, and the user rotates her toys every few days; the user is considering feather or fabric wand toys, vertical sisal scratching posts, and a cat tree, and tracks Luna’s vaccinations and vet appointments in a spreadsheet. The user also owns a male Maltese and has had difficulty trimming his nails; the user chose a Safari Professional Nail File and planned gentler grooming and regular brushing to prevent mats.

Ferrari 288 GTO scale-model project: began around 2023-03-26, on a rainy Sunday, with about five hours spent assembling the basic chassis and engine block; worked on it sporadically afterward. Around 2023-04-08, applied model-specific decals to the engine compartment and body and was pleased with the result. By 2023-04-15, had acquired and tested a new airbrush compressor, which gave smoother, more even coats, and planned to paint next; considered weathering, paint chipping with masking tape, engine wiring and hoses, and interior detailing. At a model-building club meetup, a fellow enthusiast demonstrated the masking-tape paint-chipping method, which the user wanted to try.

Writing practice and possible blog: by 2023-04-15, the user was trying to maintain a consistent writing habit and found realistic goals helpful for avoiding burnout; scheduling writing sessions in a planner had helped. The user had written “Lost in the Woods,” begun spontaneously during a camping trip in early August of an unspecified year, drafted mostly in the phone Notes app on the bus home, then transferred it to a laptop. On 2023-04-15, a new mechanical keyboard was helping the user enter a writing flow state and make fewer typos. From 2023-04-15 through 2023-05-06, the user considered starting a writing blog, brainstormed names and themes, and had not committed or set it up; possible themes included creativity, productivity, personal experiences, motivation, writer’s block, and writing technology. The user follows The Write Practice and ProBlogger and had been experimenting with an app referred to as “Uly” by the user and Ulysses by the assistant.

Japan trip planning: on 2023-03-? (the trip was described as planned for March 2024), the user compared a Shinjuku hostel at $30 per night with a Harajuku Airbnb at $50 per night for a cherry-blossom-season trip. By 2023-04-15, the user wanted a central Tokyo base, planned to use a Japan Rail Pass for JR trains and a Suica card for local transit, and was considering visits to Fushimi Inari Shrine in Kyoto, Tokyo Tower, and Tsukiji Fish Market in Tokyo. The user decided to prioritize a central Tokyo location but had not specified which accommodation; they also asked about food and shrine customs.

Homemade tortillas and Mexican cooking: during the week before 2023-04-15, the user’s first tortilla attempt went badly because the dough was too sticky and the tortillas were uneven, fragile, and fell apart when folded. A few days later, the user added flour and rested the dough longer; the tortillas improved and were used for chicken fajitas with sautéed onions and bell peppers. On 2023-04-15, the user was excited to explore more Mexican dishes and planned a Portobello mushroom and Oaxaca cheese filling with sautéed onions and garlic, oregano, and lime, served with pico de gallo and topped with pickled onions, cilantro, queso fresco, and possibly radishes.

Education Ph.D. exploration: on 2023-03-18, the user was considering returning to school for a Ph.D., especially in education, educational leadership, and policy. The user connected effective leadership and policy to educational outcomes and was particularly interested in urban education, policy and reform, teacher evaluation and development, teacher diversity, equity, and cultural responsiveness. On 2023-06-15, attending the user's niece’s high school graduation prompted reflection on the user's education journey and reinforced the importance of supportive, diverse, inclusive learning environments. No application or enrollment decision is recorded.

Cardiovascular questionnaire intervention: on 2023-04-11, the user was developing an intervention for adults aged 45 or older to complete an online cardiovascular-health questionnaire. The discussion identified barriers involving habit cues and competing routines, inconsistent or weak reinforcement, inadequate or unappealing rewards, difficult eligibility requirements, accessibility, and distrust. A proposed reward-loop explanation was that personal cardiovascular information, access to resources and support, and satisfaction from contributing to research and public health could reinforce participation and encourage repeat completion.

Maltese grooming: on 2023-04-15, the user reported difficulty trimming the male Maltese’s nails and asked how to make grooming more comfortable. The user chose the Safari Professional Nail File and planned to be more patient and gentle, try the suggested grooming approaches, and brush regularly to prevent mats. The advice discussed gradual tool familiarization, brief sessions, treats and praise, careful filing while avoiding the quick, and professional help for persistent difficulty or severe mats.

Yoga practice and social content: on 2023-03-24, the user wanted to get back into yoga because the old mat was worn out and sought an eco-friendly, non-slip mat around 4–5 mm thick for Hatha and Vinyasa. The user had posted a 15-second morning-yoga TikTok that received 100 views and was planning a consistent social-media content calendar. The user liked a Morning Routine Series and selected Tree Pose (Vrksasana) for the first Pose of the Week post. The user also asked about beginner options at Yoga to the People; no visit or mat purchase is recorded.
The user reported one TikTok video of a morning yoga routine reaching 100 views by 2023-03-24.
As of 2023-04-15, the user had recorded 43 bird species on a personal life list and had seen Mourning Doves and Red-shouldered Hawks.
In the month before 2023-04-15, the user made three online Starbucks orders worth about $20 each and earned 120 Starbucks Rewards stars total; the user had recently reached Platinum status.
On 2023-04-14, the user estimated Amazon Prime had saved about $20 in shipping across four online orders totaling more than $150.
